name: Octopus
otherStatistics: Perception +2 and Stealth +4. Darkvision 30 ft., passive Perception 12. No listed languages.
appearance: A russet octopus with a rounded mantle, horizontal pupils, and eight tapering arms with pale suckers.

sections.Printed source: D&D Basic Rules, v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 146.
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. Out of water, the octopus can go 30 minutes without taking a breath.
Underwater Camouflage. Roll Dexterity (Stealth) checks with advantage while underwater.
Water Breathing. Breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 1 bludgeoning damage and grapples the target (escape DC 10). Until the grapple ends, the octopus can use Tentacles only on that target.
Ink Cloud (recharges after a short or long rest). As an action while underwater, release ink in a 5-ft. radius around the octopus. That area is heavily obscured for 1 minute unless a strong current disperses the ink sooner. After releasing ink, the octopus can Dash as a bonus action.
sections.At the table: Apply the grapple on a hit. The target can spend an action to attempt a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape. A creature trying to see something in the ink is effectively blinded for that purpose.

name: Vulture
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A brown scavenging bird with a bare grey head and neck, a hooked beak, a pale feather ruff, and broad wings.

sections.Printed source: D&D Basic Rules, v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 157.
sections.Traits:
Keen Sight and Smell. Roll Wisdom (Perception) checks with advantage when using sight or smell.
Pack Tactics. Attack rolls against a creature have advantage if at least one ally of the vulture is within 5 ft. of that creature and is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
